mapper.select: SELECT id, title, updated_at FROM projects ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id = #{id})
SELECT id, logo FROM projects WHERE id = #{id}
INSERT INTO projects (id, title, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{updatedAt}) RETURNING id, title, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET theme = #{theme}, updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{id} AND theme IS NOT #{theme}
UPDATE projects SET logo = #{logo}, updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id = #{id} AND logo IS NOT #{logo}
